title: Tentative acceptance depends on an outstanding inspection

correspondence.subject: OPH-542 ramp acceptance
correspondence.body: The ramp handover for OPH-542 looks acceptable on paper, and I expect we can sign it off if tomorrow's load inspection is clean. Please do not treat this note as final acceptance; the inspector has not visited yet. I will confirm after the inspection. Beth

requirements.name: Ramp handover acceptance
requirements.description: Obtain final acceptance after the load inspection.
